svg.text: Frontend → Backend API → Data Layer / AI-Model Layer / RAG-Orchestration Layer

g.text: imported by every page above — nav, active-route highlight, logout
lib/types.ts — TS interfaces mirroring every backend response shape

svg.text: lib/api.ts — the ONLY file that calls fetch() to the backend
Client Components → apiFetch() → /api/proxy/[...path] Route Handler (reads httpOnly JWT cookie, attaches Authorization header) → FastAPI
Server Components (e.g. dashboard's page()) → apiFetchServer() → reads cookie via next/headers → FastAPI directly, cache: "no-store"
registers every router · lifespan() builds ModelManager
auth_service.py (get_current_user, JWT verify) · notification_service.py (notify_once — dedup'd writes used by exam/career/dashboard/learning.py) · rate_limit.py
schemas/ — Pydantic request/response validation for every router above
questions seeded from mentora_data/processed/m1 — 2,155 real rows
lazy-load · idle-unload (5 min) · heavy_lock semaphore · asyncio.to_thread
ml_core/registry.py builds this registry once at startup from ml_models/saved/
ChromaDB — vector_store/ (local, on-disk: exam_kb / career_kb / interview_kb)
via langchain_groq.ChatGroq.ainvoke() — not serialized behind heavy_lock
RAGUnavailableError on any Groq failure → graceful "temporarily unavailable" response
OFFLINE PIPELINES (run before the live system above exists)

g.text: parity check vs. FP32 on real examples

svg.text: Always-resident model (loaded at startup, never unloaded)
* M5's 0.9497 Entity F1 is measured on an auto-tagged gold split, not a manually hand-corrected one — see §4.3's caveat.
M1, M2, M3 did not meet their original target metrics (documented, root-caused in §4.3) — M4 and M5 did. All 5 are live in production regardless;
this is a deliberate decision to ship honestly-measured real models rather than withhold a working system over missed accuracy targets.
Generated 2026-11-14 from the live codebase — see docs/MENTORA_TECHNICAL_MANUAL.md for the full written manual this diagram accompanies.
